steps.en: Only AC-ADMIN staff can open Manage Modules
steps.id: Hanya staff AC-ADMIN yang bisa membuka Manage Modules
steps.why_en: Only the menu is restricted; nothing behind the screen checks the role.
steps.why_id: Hanya menu yang dibatasi; di balik layar tidak mengecek role.

steps.en: Staff sees the list of all modules
Staff can search the module list
steps.id: Staff bisa mencari di daftar module

steps.en: Staff can sort the list by column
steps.id: Staff bisa mengurutkan daftar per kolom
steps.why_en: The list has a fixed order by name; no sort control.
steps.why_id: Daftar hanya berurutan tetap menurut nama; tidak ada kontrol sort.

steps.en: Staff can export the shown list to Excel
steps.id: Staff bisa mengekspor daftar yang tampil ke Excel
steps.why_en: The export is a CSV file, not an Excel file.
steps.why_id: Hasil ekspor berupa file CSV, bukan file Excel.

steps.en: Add New Module opens the module form
steps.id: Add New Module membuka form module

steps.en: Submitting the form creates the module
Editing a module changes only its description
steps.why_en: The screen locks other fields, but the system still accepts a name change.
steps.why_id: Layar mengunci kolom lain, tetapi di balik layar masih menerima ganti nama.

steps.en: Delete asks for confirmation, then removes the module
steps.id: Hapus meminta konfirmasi, lalu module dihapus

steps.en: Deleting a module also removes its roles and functions
steps.id: Hapus module ikut menghapus role dan function-nya
steps.why_en: Functions and role mappings are removed, but the roles themselves stay.
steps.why_id: Function dan mapping role ikut terhapus, tetapi role-nya tetap ada.

steps.en: Staff sees an error message when something fails
steps.id: Staff melihat pesan error saat ada yang gagal
steps.why_en: The error message is generic, and missing-module cases show no error.
steps.why_id: Pesan error bersifat umum, dan kasus module tidak ada tidak menampilkan error.

steps.en: Module changes take effect without approval
steps.id: Perubahan module langsung berlaku tanpa approval
